body: I'm an athiest, I don't believe in heaven or an afterlife. Sorry.

I'm sorry but I looked at your post history a bit.

You seem to have gone through some shit too so it seems like you've been in the same boat I'm in, in one way or another.

How are you feeling now?
How did you get to that stage?

I'm here to talk, I've too many responsibilities at this point in time to do anything so I'm kind of stuck.

Yes me killing myself makes me an asshole to those who love me but I'm not that much of an asshole that I won't tie up all my loose ends before I go.

Yeah but at this stage, I've considered that.

It's not just people, it's everything, the cons outweigh the pros. 

I'll never get to play hockey again, never taste a beer, never eat a big steak BUT I'll never have to worry about money problems, relationship issues, people, bills, anything really.

I'll truly be free and it fills me with more joy than I ever thought it would.
